title: Hyatt Introduces Enhanced Hyatt Leverage Platform for Small-and-Midsize Business Travel
summary: CHICAGO, IL (October 30, 2026) – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the evolution of Hyatt Leverage – Hyatt’s all-in-one online business travel platform for eligible...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO, IL (October 30, 2026)** – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the evolution of Hyatt Leverage – Hyatt’s all-in-one online business travel platform for eligible small-and-midsize businesses – designed to take friction out of the corporate travel booking process. The redesigned Hyatt Leverage platform offers exclusive rates across more than 1,300 Hyatt hotels, along with enhancements to the booking and administration experience that help clients manage corporate travel in one centralized place.


Eligible Hyatt Leverage clients, whether small business owners or travel decision makers at fast-growing regional organizations, can take advantage of preferred Hyatt rates at more than 1,300 hotels and access end-to-end travel management through a modern booking experience.


Core Hyatt Leverage benefits include:


- **Seamless, all-in-one travel management** – book, view and manage reservations, travel spend, payments, and much more, all in one place.
- **Exclusive rates at more than 1,300 Hyatt hotels** – access to preferred room rates across Hyatt’s five brand portfolios in destinations around the world. From Classics brands like Hyatt Regency offering impeccable service and thoughtful amenities to Essentials portfolio brands like Hyatt Studios, designed for comfortable extended stays, Hyatt offers brands and destinations for every travel occasion.
- **World of Hyatt program benefits for both administrators and travelers** – earn points for eligible travel and redeem them for free nights, suite upgrades, World of Hyatt FIND experiences, and more.


“Small-and-midsize businesses have long represented a critical segment for Hyatt hotels and the broader global business travel market. Today’s travelers want greater personalization, collaboration and a seamless experience, and Hyatt Leverage makes booking and managing travel even easier through these new enhancements,” said Alice Harrington-Caravello, Senior Vice President, Global Sales and Americas Commercial Services, Hyatt. “We continuously listen to our customers and guests, guided by our purpose of care, to adapt and introduce tools that better meet their needs.”


Hyatt Leverage is now powered by Spotnana, a Travel-as-a-Service platform that enables an integrated booking experience. Eligible clients can access Hyatt Leverage and book preferred rates at[www.hyatt.com/leverage](http://www.hyatt.com/leverage) .


Thousands of clients across the world continue to choose Hyatt Leverage when booking travel for their teams. According to Stacy Slater, EVP of Investor Relations, Capital Markets & Corporate Strategy at Brixmor Property Group, the user experience is paramount, noting “Hyatt Leverage offers a compelling combination of discounted rates, global reach, and flexibility, helping us manage travel efficiently while delivering a strong experience for our employees.”


Hasan Ehtisham, Director of Firm Management at Quantbot Technologies LP, highlights how Hyatt Leverage is helping “make travel management easier, with more access and better value for our employees globally.”


To be eligible for Hyatt Leverage, clients must meet criteria that include being legally organized in their country of origin, being considered a small-or-midsize business, achieving a minimum of 50 actualized room nights per year. Hyatt Leverage is not available for bookings made through a travel agency, consortia or other online booking tool. Select existing Hyatt Leverage clients have already been migrated to the new platform.


To learn more about Hyatt Leverage, contact a Hyatt representative, or reapply for eligibility, visit[www.hyatt.com/leverage](https://www.hyatt.com/leverage) .


*The term “Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 84 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the *Luxury Portfolio* , including ***Park Hyatt*** ®, ***Alila*** ®, ***Miraval*** ®, ***Impression by Secrets*** , and ***The Unbound Collection by Hyatt*** ®; the *Lifestyle Portfolio* , including ***Andaz*** ®, ***Thompson Hotels*** ®, ***The Standard*** ®, ***Dream*** ® ***Hotels*** , ***The StandardX*** ®, ***Breathless Resorts & Spas*** ®, ***JdV by Hyatt*** ®, ***Bunkhouse*** ® ***Hotels*** , and ***Me and All Hotels*** ; the *Inclusive Collection* , including ***Zoëtry*** ® ***Wellness & Spa Resorts*** , ***Hyatt Ziva*** ®, ***Hyatt Zilara*** ®, ***Secrets*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Dreams*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Hyatt Vivid*** ® ***Hotels & Resorts*** , ***Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts*** ®, and ***Sunscape*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** *;* the *Classics Portfolio* , including ***Grand Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Regency*** ®, ***Destination by Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Centric*** ®, ***Hyatt Vacation Club*** ®, and ***Hyatt*** ®; and the *Essentials Portfolio* , including ***Caption by Hyatt*** ®, **Unscripted by Hyatt** ®, ***Hyatt Place*** ®, ***Hyatt House*** ®, ***Hyatt Studios*** ®, **Hyatt Select** ® **,** and ***UrCove*** . Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith®, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit *www.hyatt.com* .
